# AGENTS.md — this OpenSpace site

This repository is an OpenSpace website. The content and design choices live here; the code
lives in versioned npm packages (`@openspace/site-kit`). Publishing happens automatically when
changes land on `main` (`.github/workflows/publish.yml`).

## Rules

1. **Content lives in `content/`.** Never hand-edit `src/`, `astro.config.mjs` or the
   workflow unless you were asked for a custom block (`src/overrides/`).
2. **Preserve ids.** Every page (`pg_`), section (`sec_`), block (`blk_`), media item (`med_`)
   and form (`frm_`) has a stable id. Keep ids when editing; new ids are the prefix plus 10
   lowercase Crockford base32 characters (no i, l, o, u).
3. **Only valid block types and fields** (listed below; full JSON Schema at
   https://schema.openspace.dev/v1/). Unknown fields fail the build.
4. **Styles change through tokens** in `content/styles.json` (palette, type pairing, density,
   shape…), never inline CSS. Sections pick one of five color themes.
5. **Never put secrets in content** (API keys, tokens, passwords). `openspace check` fails on them.
   Gated pages (members / password) are not stored in this repository.
6. **Run `npx openspace check` before committing.** It validates schemas, links, image references,
   size budgets and scans for secrets.
7. Write real copy in the owner's voice. No placeholder text, no invented testimonials, prices
   or facts — ask the owner.

## Layout

```
openspace.json               site id, Hub URL, deploy target, features (https://schema.openspace.dev/v1/site-config.json)
content/site.json            title, navigation, header, footer, SEO defaults, redirects
content/styles.json          design tokens and Site Styles choices
content/media.json           metadata for files in media/ (alt text, size, focal point, credit)
content/pages/home.json      the home page (slug ""); other pages mirror their URL:
content/pages/about.json     → /about/      content/pages/services/pricing.json → /services/pricing/
content/collections/<name>/_collection.json   collection kind, list + item page layout, feeds
content/collections/<name>/<slug>.mdoc        one item: YAML frontmatter + Markdoc body
media/                       images ≤ 2400px on the long edge, audio, files
```

A page is `{ id, title, slug, seo?, sections: [...] }`; a section has a `layout` (`stack` with
column spans that add up to 12, or `grid`) and `blocks`; a block is
`{ id, type, v, fields, variant?, style? }`.

## Collection items (Markdoc)

Frontmatter follows the collection kind (blog, events, portfolio, podcast, products): `title`,
`status` (draft | scheduled | published), `publishAt` for scheduled items, `excerpt`, `image`,
`categories`, `tags`, plus kind-specific fields (`date`, `start`/`end`, `price` in minor units…).

The body is Markdown prose plus Markdoc tags. **Tags map 1:1 to blocks**: the tag name is the
block type, attributes are its fields, and content between the tags fills its text:

```markdoc
{% gallery layout="grid" images=["media/2026/10/a.jpg", "media/2026/10/b.jpg"] /%}

{% button href="/schedule" variant="primary" %}See the schedule{% /button %}
```

No scripts or raw HTML: anything interactive is a block.

## Running locally

- `npm install`, then `npm run dev` for a live preview.
- `npx openspace mcp` starts the local MCP server so an AI assistant can edit through the same
  structured operations as the Studio.
- `npm run build` builds the site into `dist/` exactly as the publish workflow does.

## Blocks

### `accordion` — Accordion / FAQ

Expandable questions and answers, with schema.org FAQPage markup. Use: FAQs, policies, class or service details — anything visitors scan for one answer. 4–10 items works best. Avoid: Hiding essential information (prices, hours) only inside an accordion; answers longer than a short paragraph or list.

- Variants: `lines`, `cards`, `minimal`
- Fields: `items: list of { question: text ≤ 160, answer: richText }`, `exclusive: boolean`, `openFirst: boolean`, `faqSchema: boolean`

### `button` — Button

A clear call to action linking to a page, booking tool, email or file. Use: Once per screenful for the main action. Add a second (secondary-style) action only when it's a genuine alternative. Avoid: Several primary buttons side by side; vague labels like 'Click here' or 'Learn more' without context.

- Variants: `default`, `large`, `full-width`
- Fields: `label: text ≤ 40`, `link: link`, `role: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary"`, `secondaryLabel?: text ≤ 40`, `secondaryLink?: link`, `note?: text ≤ 120`

### `card` — Card

One self-contained item — a service, offer, event or article teaser — with an optional link. Use: Place 2–4 cards side by side in stack columns for services or offers. `overlay` sets text on the photo; `horizontal` suits wide columns. Avoid: Long body text (keep under ~40 words); different aspect ratios across cards in a row.

- Variants: `stacked`, `horizontal`, `overlay`, `minimal`
- Fields: `image?: image { src, alt }`, `aspect: "original" | "1:1" | "4:5" | "2:3" | "3:2" | "16:9" | "21:9"`, `icon?: "check" | "star" | "heart" | "leaf" | "sprout" | "flower" | "sun" | "moon" | "sparkles" | "mountain" | "waves" | "map-pin" | "phone" | "mail" | "message-circle" | "clock" | "calendar" | "coffee" | "utensils" | "music" | "camera" | "palette" | "brush" | "book-open" | "graduation-cap" | "user" | "users" | "heart-handshake" | "home" | "shield-check" | "lock" | "award" | "target" | "lightbulb" | "zap" | "rocket" | "gift" | "shopping-bag" | "package" | "truck" | "recycle" | "globe" | "wifi" | "car" | "bike" | "dumbbell" | "accessibility" | "baby" | "dog" | "paw-print" | "scissors" | "wrench" | "arrow-right"`, `eyebrow?: text ≤ 40`, `heading: text ≤ 90`, `body: richText`, `link?: link`, `linkLabel?: text ≤ 30`

### `columns` — Columns

Parallel content in columns: a feature trio, numbered steps, or short offers. Use: When 2–4 items share the same shape. `steps` numbers them for a process; `cards` puts each on a surface. Avoid: Uneven text lengths across columns; more than four columns; long paragraphs.

- Variants: `plain`, `cards`, `steps`
- Fields: `items: list of { image?: image { src, alt }, heading: text ≤ 80, body: richText, link?: link, linkLabel?: text ≤ 30 }`, `columns: "2" | "3" | "4"`, `aspect: "original" | "1:1" | "4:5" | "2:3" | "3:2" | "16:9" | "21:9"`

### `embed` — Embed / Code

Embeds third-party widgets (booking, surveys, tickets, playlists) by URL or HTML snippet. Use: Only when no dedicated block exists for the service. Avoid: Tracking scripts; snippets with secrets or API keys; embedding YouTube/Vimeo (use the video block) or maps (use the map block).

- Variants: `plain`, `framed`
- Fields: `embed: embed`, `title: text ≤ 120`, `aspect: "auto" | "16:9" | "4:3" | "1:1"`, `height: number`

### `form` — Form

Collects enquiries, bookings requests, RSVPs or applications into the owner's Inbox. Use: Contact pages and anywhere visitors need to send structured details. Pair with a short text block explaining what happens next. Avoid: Long forms (keep under ~8 fields); asking for sensitive data; password or payment fields (not allowed — payments go through checkout).

- Variants: `default`, `card`, `underline`
- Fields: `form: form`

### `gallery` — Gallery

Several related photographs shown together. Use: Portfolios, spaces, events and products. `grid` for tidy sets, `masonry` and `strips` for mixed orientations, `carousel` for many images in little space, `slideshow` for one large image at a time. Avoid: Mixing unrelated photos; fewer than three images (use the image block); captions that repeat alt text.

- Variants: `grid`, `carousel`, `masonry`, `slideshow`, `strips`
- Fields: `images: list of { image: image { src, alt }, caption?: text ≤ 160, link?: link }`, `aspect: "auto" | "original" | "1:1" | "4:5" | "2:3" | "3:2" | "16:9" | "21:9"`, `columns: "2" | "3" | "4" | "5"`, `lightbox: boolean`, `showCaptions: boolean`

### `icon-list` — Icon list

A scannable list of features, amenities, benefits or what's included. Use: Services and pricing pages, 'what to expect' sections. 3–8 items. Avoid: Using icons that don't match the meaning; paragraphs instead of one-line points.

- Variants: `list`, `tiles`, `checklist`
- Fields: `items: list of { icon: "check" | "star" | "heart" | "leaf" | "sprout" | "flower" | "sun" | "moon" | "sparkles" | "mountain" | "waves" | "map-pin" | "phone" | "mail" | "message-circle" | "clock" | "calendar" | "coffee" | "utensils" | "music" | "camera" | "palette" | "brush" | "book-open" | "graduation-cap" | "user" | "users" | "heart-handshake" | "home" | "shield-check" | "lock" | "award" | "target" | "lightbulb" | "zap" | "rocket" | "gift" | "shopping-bag" | "package" | "truck" | "recycle" | "globe" | "wifi" | "car" | "bike" | "dumbbell" | "accessibility" | "baby" | "dog" | "paw-print" | "scissors" | "wrench" | "arrow-right", title: text ≤ 60, text?: text ≤ 200 }`, `columns: "1" | "2" | "3" | "4"`

### `image` — Image

A single photograph or illustration. Use: To show the place, the people, the work or the product. Keep aspect ratios consistent within a section. `caption-overlay` suits atmospheric shots; `inset` frames an image on a soft surface. Avoid: Stock photos that don't depict the business; text baked into images; missing alt text.

- Variants: `default`, `caption-overlay`, `inset`
- Fields: `image: image { src, alt }`, `aspect: "original" | "1:1" | "4:5" | "2:3" | "3:2" | "16:9" | "21:9"`, `caption?: text ≤ 200`, `link?: link`, `lightbox: boolean`

### `line` — Line

A visual divider between pieces of content. Use: To separate groups inside a section, or as a short accent rule above a heading (`length: short`, color `accent`). Avoid: Lines between every block; using lines where whitespace or a section change would do.

- Variants: `solid`, `dashed`, `dotted`, `fade`
- Fields: `thickness: "hairline" | "regular" | "bold"`, `length: "full" | "half" | "short"`, `color: color`

### `logo-strip` — Logo strip

Logos of publications, clients, partners or certifications. Use: Below a hero or near a call to action as social proof. 4–8 logos reads best. Avoid: Logos without permission or for relationships that don't exist; mixing press and clients in one strip.

- Variants: `row`, `grid`, `marquee`
- Fields: `label?: text ≤ 60`, `logos: list of { name: text ≤ 60, logo?: image { src, alt }, link?: link }`, `monochrome: boolean`

### `map` — Map

Shows where a place is, with the address and a link to full maps. Use: Contact and visit pages for any business with a physical location. Set latitude/longitude precisely; add parking or access notes in details. Avoid: Guessing coordinates — ask the owner or geocode the exact address; maps for online-only businesses.

- Variants: `card`, `plain`, `split`
- Fields: `name?: text ≤ 80`, `address: text ≤ 200`, `latitude: number`, `longitude: number`, `zoom: number`, `details?: text ≤ 240`, `linkLabel: text ≤ 40`, `tileServer?: text ≤ 300`, `aspect: "16:9" | "3:2" | "4:3" | "1:1"`

### `newsletter` — Newsletter signup

Collects email subscribers (double opt-in) for the owner's newsletter. Use: Footers, the end of blog posts, and dedicated 'stay in touch' sections. Say what subscribers get and how often. Avoid: Promising content or frequency the owner hasn't agreed to; more than one signup per page.

- Variants: `inline`, `stacked`, `card`, `banner`
- Fields: `heading?: text ≤ 80`, `description?: text ≤ 240`, `askName: boolean`, `placeholder: text ≤ 60`, `buttonLabel: text ≤ 30`, `successMessage: text ≤ 200`, `note?: text ≤ 160`

### `quote` — Quote

A short, memorable quotation set apart from body text. Use: To pause the reader between sections, or to open a page with an epigraph. `large` is a centred statement, `bar` sits inside reading text. Avoid: Customer reviews (use testimonial); misattributed or invented quotes; quotes longer than three sentences.

- Variants: `classic`, `large`, `bar`
- Fields: `quote: richText`, `attribution?: text ≤ 80`, `source?: text ≤ 120`

### `shape` — Shape

Decorative shapes (blob, arch, sparkle, squiggle…) in palette colors. Use: In grid sections, layered behind or beside images and text to add warmth and brand character. Keep to one or two per section. Avoid: Using shapes to carry meaning or text; bright shapes behind body text that hurt contrast.

- Variants: `solid`, `outline`, `soft`
- Fields: `shape: "circle" | "ring" | "blob" | "arch" | "half-circle" | "pill" | "squircle" | "triangle" | "sparkle" | "star" | "flower" | "wave"`, `color: color`, `size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "fill"`, `rotate: number`, `stretch: boolean`

### `share-buttons` — Share buttons

Share links for the page being viewed (blog posts, events, announcements). Use: At the end of articles and event pages. Avoid: Putting share buttons on every page; more than four or five networks.

- Variants: `icons`, `labels`, `pills`
- Fields: `label?: text ≤ 40`, `networks: list of { network: "x" | "facebook" | "linkedin" | "bluesky" | "threads" | "pinterest" | "email" }`

### `social-links` — Social links

Links to the owner's social media and email. Use: Footers, contact and about pages. Prefer `source: site` so profiles stay in sync across the site. Avoid: Linking to inactive accounts; more than ~6 networks.

- Variants: `icons`, `labels`, `pills`
- Fields: `source: "site" | "custom"`, `profiles: list of { network: "instagram" | "facebook" | "x" | "threads" | "bluesky" | "mastodon" | "linkedin" | "youtube" | "tiktok" | "pinterest" | "github" | "spotify" | "soundcloud" | "bandcamp" | "vimeo" | "behance" | "dribbble" | "substack" | "patreon" | "yelp" | "tripadvisor" | "email" | "website", url: text ≤ 300 }`, `label?: text ≤ 60`

### `spacer` — Spacer

Extra vertical space between blocks, sized from the site's spacing scale. Use: Sparingly, to give a heading or image more air than the default block gap. Avoid: Stacking spacers; using spacers to fake section padding (adjust the section instead).

- Variants: —
- Fields: `height: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl"`, `mobileHeight?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl"`

### `testimonial` — Testimonial

A short quote from a client or customer, attributed to a named person. Use: Social proof near a call to action or on a services page. Use three side by side (`card`) or one `large` testimonial as a section's centrepiece. Avoid: Inventing testimonials or ratings. Ask the owner for real quotes and permission to use names and photos.

- Variants: `card`, `large`, `minimal`
- Fields: `quote: richText`, `name: text ≤ 80`, `role?: text ≤ 100`, `photo?: image { src, alt }`, `rating?: number`

### `text` — Text

Running text: headings, paragraphs, lists and pull quotes. Use: Any time words carry the section — introductions, stories, policies. Use `columns` for long reading text, `drop-cap` for editorial openings, `callout` for a note that must stand out. Avoid: Walls of text; more than one H1 per page; using bold paragraphs as fake headings. Use the button block for calls to action.

- Variants: `default`, `columns`, `drop-cap`, `callout`
- Fields: `content: richText`

### `video` — Video

A video from YouTube, Vimeo or PeerTube, or an uploaded video file. Use: Walkthroughs, talks, trailers and atmosphere. The player loads only when a visitor presses play, so pages stay fast. Avoid: Autoplaying sound; background loops longer than ~20 seconds; using a video where a photo says the same thing.

- Variants: `default`, `framed`, `cinematic`
- Fields: `source: "embed" | "file"`, `url?: text ≤ 500`, `file?: media`, `title: text ≤ 120`, `poster?: image { src, alt }`, `caption?: text ≤ 200`, `aspect: "16:9" | "21:9" | "4:3" | "1:1" | "9:16"`, `background: boolean`
